checks.description: LaTeX compiles to PDF without fatal errors
Uses the bundled iclr2027_conference.sty on the article class
Main text within the page limit (9 pages for submission, 10 for camera-ready; the statements, acknowledgements, references and appendices do not count)
US Letter paper (8.5 x 11 in)
All fonts embedded in the PDF
No packages that change the ICLR margins, spacing or headings
Has the AI use statement ICLR 2027 requires (it does not count toward the page limit)
Abstract present (one paragraph)
Submission names no authors
Every referenced figure file is present and embeddable
Every citation key has a bibliography entry
No undefined \ref labels
Paper has a reference list
No text sticking into the margin (overfull boxes larger than 5pt)
Every character prints (no glyphs missing from the font)
Abstract is one paragraph
Ethics and reproducibility statements (recommended; they do not count toward the page limit)
British or American spelling, not both
Abbreviations are spelled out at first use
No plain underscores in the text
Images print at 150 dpi or more
Review version gives no hint of the authors (self-citations, links, emails, grants)
No leftover notes to self (\todo, TODO, FIXME)

params.message: The paper still has notes to self. Remove them, or write the missing text, before you submit.

checks.description: Typed figure and table numbers match the paper, and every figure and table has a caption

manual_review_items: Author names, affiliations and emails were copied from your upload; confirm them in the camera-ready version.
Equation, table and figure placement may differ from your original layout.
